title: Sovereign Deterministic Verification of Foundational Lemmas for the Millennium Problems
description: This preprint documents a deterministic, zero-sorry formal verification framework targeting the foundational lemmas underlying the seven Clay Millennium Prize Problems. We pair the Lean 4 proof assistant (1,943 build-log-checked jobs, 0 sorry) with the Z3 SMT solver (74 cross-verified theorems, 100% UNSAT) in a dual-engine certification pipeline. We verify supporting lemmas—not full resolutions—covering zeta functional symmetry, Chebyshev prime bounds, Swarm-Hamiltonian energy dissipation, and a-priori Navier-Stokes estimates.
notes: Working draft v0.3. Internal preprint. All verification artifacts reproducible via 'lake build' and 'python3 z3_tribunal_verify.py'.
